messages:
Evelyn Park: Morning! Quick onboarding Qs — my corp Chromebook is arriving late. Can I use it when it arrives, or should I use my personal Mac for the first couple days? Also, is there a mandatory window for the privacy + security modules and the phishing sim? Lastly, any special policy for webcam/screenshare during training?

onboard-bot: Hi Evelyn — welcome! Please complete the privacy and security modules within 72 hours of your start date. Phishing simulation will auto-enroll you within 48-72h. Device guidance: personal devices allowed short-term with encryption and screen lock. See https://redwood.co/onboarding.

Maya (People Ops): Welcome :sparkles: You can use a personal Mac for up to 72 hours provided: FileVault enabled, latest OS updates, a separate work user, and no local retention of customer data. Chromebook is fine once it arrives, but Chromebooks require MDM enrollment and vetted ChromeOS policy before accessing internal systems. I can mark an exception if you need more time.

Samir (Security): Short notes: 1) Corp device preferred for any access to customer logs or PII. 2) Webcam/screenshare policy during training — background blur is recommended but not mandatory; don't record training sessions. 3) If you're on a personal device, do not mount external backups that might sync company files.

IT Shipbot: Shipping update: Chromebook tracking #CHRB-44912 shows delivery ETA 2 business days. YubiKey & onboarding kit are in the same shipment. If you need temporary VPN token, reply with 'request-token' here.

Evelyn Park: Thanks — I'll enable FileVault now. If I opt for the Chromebook when it arrives, do I need to wait for IT to finish setup before logging in to Slack/Google?

Maya (People Ops): Yes, wait for the MDM enrollment to complete. IT will DM you with a one-time enrollment link. If you try to sign in before enrollment, some resources will be blocked. I'll follow up once IT confirms.

Claire (Legal): Heads up on training: please don't discuss any confidential customer info in public Slack channels during your first two weeks until your account is fully provisioned and you've completed the privacy module. This is standard.

Samir (Security): Practical commands if you need to check FileVault on macOS:
```
sudo fdesetup status
system_profiler SPSoftwareDataType | grep 'System Version'
```
Paste the output here if you want us to confirm. Also, if you fail an initial phish, it's only a coaching trigger — we use it to improve awareness.

Evelyn Park: fdesetup status shows 'FileVault is On.' System Version is 'macOS 13.4'. Thanks everyone. I'll wait for IT enrollment on the Chromebook and complete the modules today.

Maya (People Ops): Perfect, thanks for confirming :white_check_mark: If anything blocks you from finishing the modules today ping me and we can reschedule. Chromebook ETA noted; will DM you when the MDM link is ready.

Evelyn Park: Appreciate the help — excited to get started! :smile:
